reason: Hypothesis: 2-bit weights in most layers reduce memory, while protecting value and down projections plus embeddings and output head at 4 bits may preserve extraction quality and decode throughput. Measure it against the identical gates; accept only if both retain at least 95% of BF16. No 2-bit recipe has measured results yet.
risk: It may miss the quality or throughput threshold. The supplied evidence only shows that int4-g128 passed 20 extraction tasks and heldout, at 2.43 GB versus 8.17 GB for BF16; it does not establish mixed2-4 performance.
